development_reinterpretation: Because validation and calibration outcomes have already been opened in Phases 1C/1D, all 5,400 non-training GSV queries are now treated explicitly as exploratory development evidence.

phase1e_go_gate.full_safety: full PEAV itself must satisfy the same pooled and 8-of-9 city safety rule
phase1e_go_gate.full_vs_comparator_cost: full PEAV mean depth at least 20% lower than strongest adaptive comparator
phase1e_go_gate.predictive_component: Full AUPRC > max(G,I) at >=2 depths and >=0.02 at >=1 depth

protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.cluster: physical query; all 2 retrievers x 2 backends remain together
protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.dataset_retriever_backend_results: descriptive transfer analyses; not separate tuning gates
protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.frontier_comparator: frozen strongest adaptive comparator selected only on development
protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.frontier_gate: lower 95% CI for Recall@1(full-comparator) >= -0.5 pp; mean depth reduction >=20%; upper 95% CI for depth(full-comparator) < 0
protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.m100: fixed m=100 is secondary sensitivity only; controller still targets m=50
protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.primary_noninferiority: lower bound of 95% physical-query-clustered, dataset-stratified bootstrap CI for (full PEAV Recall@1 - fixed m=50 Recall@1) >= -0.5 pp
protected_primary_protocol_if_phase1e_pa.primary_pooling: equal-dataset pooling over six protected datasets

strongest_adaptive_comparator: among retrieval_scheduler, one_shot_inlier_gate, progressive_inlier_only, the feasible method with minimum pooled mean verification depth; ties higher Recall@1 then name

threshold_rule.candidate_thresholds: all empirical method probability breakpoints over the 5,400 development queries
threshold_rule.city_safety: at least 8 of 9 development cities individually within -0.5 pp of fixed m=50
threshold_rule.pooled_safety: Recall@1 >= fixed m=50 Recall@1 - 0.25 percentage points
